title: Falmec — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Falmec.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Design Ventilation." Specialty tier. Falmec makes sculptural range hoods in Vittorio Veneto, Italy — design-forward pieces that are kitchen art. Their E.Ion ionization technology purifies air beyond just extraction.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Falmec:

• Italian-made sculptural range hoods

• E.Ion air purification technology

• Design-forward kitchen statements

• Premium materials and craftsmanship

• Tasco distributed in Canada
